result.title: Occlusion for Free: Detecting Occlusion from the Disagreement Between Two Monocular Distance Cues
result.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 GlobalSouthAI Workshop
result.summary: Knowing that a pedestrian is occluded is useful to a robot even when the detector cannot recover the hidden pixels, but occlusion estimators are normally trained on occlusion annotations that deployment settings rarely have. We show that occlusion can be read off two distance estimates a camera-only pipeline already computes. Apparent height is largely unchanged by occlusion, because the detected box still spans the whole person; monocular metric depth is pulled toward the occluder, because the nearest surface inside the box is what a depth map reports. Only their ordering matters, so no focal length, stature, or depth scale is needed, provided the depth model's error is close to a pure gain, a condition that can be checked without labels. The score detects heavy occlusion on KITTI with AUC 0.909 (0.888 over all annotated pedestrians, including those the detector misses), requires no training and no occlusion labels, and is not a proxy for range: within fixed distance bands it holds AUC 0.894-0.925 while true distance alone sits near chance. On synthetic CARLA scenes with measured visibility it reaches 0.819, against 0.644 for distance alone. We arrived here after measuring three standard architectural responses to occlusion, depth fusion, occlusion-simulating augmentation, and attention, none of which improved detection outside its training distribution in the configurations we tested, and after finding that a detector trained on German roads loses half its accuracy on self-annotated street scenes in Lagos, Nigeria. Signals that need no local annotation are worth more in settings that benchmarks do not represent.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一种无需训练、无需遮挡标注的遮挡检测方法：利用「视高距离」在遮挡下基本不变、而单目度量深度会被遮挡物拉近这一分歧，仅凭两者排序差异打分，并在 KITTI（AUC 0.909）与 CARLA 合成场景上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作给出一个不依赖标注的「视觉证据是否被遮蔽」信号，可能为 LVR 中视觉旁路何时不可信、是否需要再取证据（LOOK/STOP）提供廉价线索，但它本身不做推理状态建模，与内部表示的联系需进一步核查。
